landings.edit: MODEL_SYNTAX entries carry per-model, dated dialogue-form evidence. Veo ≠ Sora named in the field text: a pasted two-speaker script block is a tested failure on Veo 3 (scene-flow prose or one speaker per segment); the Dialogue block is OpenAI's published form for Sora 2. An uncited entry is UNKNOWN and the unit defaults to Camp B single-speaker segments.

Four standing positions recorded as independently confirmed online: route-first (mandatory VOICE_ROUTE), verbatim identity blocks (LOOK_BLOCK_VERBATIM, B-13's route exception aside), one-speaker reliability / two-speaker ceiling (Camp B / F-14), reaction closes (A-4 REACTION entries). Future challenges must argue against banked AND online evidence.
Register row records the CONFIRMS filing; no field or rule changed.

At lock the hanger passes the swap test: paste-able onto another episode without rewriting this episode's middle = decoration = fail; last beat rewritten before U6's dialogue is drafted; the GATE_LOG's hanger entry records the test and the middle beat a passing hanger hangs from.
